cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Who gave you the timing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it, or are we both relying on my brother?

mechanism: A copies confident responses to a shared report while probing exactly what B knows without admitting A's own knowledge or ignorance.
confusable: S04 confused imitation differs from D06 deliberate concealment; both must operate in the same questions.
comparison: Public incident/report versus private object provenance.
seedUse: D06-a distinguishes witnessed evidence from hearsay; S04 seeds supply the misinterpreted confident cue.
